name: life
description: 计划、待办、日历、学习执行和每日复盘

capabilities.name: task_plan
capabilities.description: 为明确目标制定普通任务计划；若用户表达长期学习并需要监督，使用 study_plan

capabilities.name: study_plan
capabilities.description: 创建需要周期追问、每日学习内容、资料来源、提醒和监督的长期学习计划

capabilities.name: life_task_update
capabilities.description: 反馈计划任务完成、部分完成、延期、没做完、不会或卡住，并触发状态更新和重排

capabilities.name: life_plan_list
capabilities.description: 查看用户全部长期计划和当前选中的计划

capabilities.name: life_plan_select
capabilities.description: 按计划编号或目标名称切换当前计划

capabilities.name: today_learning
capabilities.description: 查看当前学习计划今天具体要学习的内容和来源

capabilities.name: daily_reflection
capabilities.description: 复盘今天完成、延期、未完成和逾期情况并给出明日建议

capabilities.name: reflection_history
capabilities.description: 查看最近七次每日复盘记录

capabilities.name: deadline_countdown
capabilities.description: 计算距离截止时间还有多久

capabilities.name: calendar_event
capabilities.description: 创建、查询、完成、取消或延后提醒

capabilities.name: todo
capabilities.description: 创建、查看、完成或删除独立待办

capabilities.name: diet_plan
capabilities.description: 营养、减脂、增肌等饮食规划
